name: Prof. Wellung
role: Traveling magician at the Medora rink, July 1885
bio: Prof. Wellung gave a magic and variety entertainment at the Medora rink on the Fourth of July, 1885. Two weeks later the paper mocked the show as a fraud on a trusting public.
mentions: Prof. Wellung's entertainment at the rink on the evening of the 4th.
